cookie 已失效：页面能打开但没有登录态，请求会被当匿名处理: Cookie expired: page opens but has no login state; requests will be treated as anonymous
cookie 无效：被重定向到登录页: Cookie invalid: redirected to login page
出口被上游限流，换个代理再试（不是 cookie 的问题）: Egress rate limited by upstream, try another proxy (not a cookie issue)
轮转页里没有 init(...)（cookie 可能已失效）: Rotation page has no init(...) (cookie may have expired)
代理 URL 必须以 http:// / https:// / socks5:/: Proxy URL must start with http://, https://, socks5://, or socks5h://
cookie 解析失败：既不是 \"k=v; k=v\" 串，也不是可识别的 J: Failed to parse cookie: neither "k=v; k=v" string nor recognizable JSON
超长对话转附件失败: Failed to convert long prompt to attachment
取上传页面参数失败: Failed to get upload page parameters
，但缺 SAPISID（算不出授权头，部分接口会被当匿名）: , but missing SAPISID (cannot sign auth header, some APIs treated as anonymous)
cookie 里没有 SAPISID，多半没复制全（需要 gemini.goog: Missing SAPISID in cookie, likely incomplete (need full cookie from gemini.google.com, at least SID / HSID / SSID / APISID / SAPISID / __Secure-1PSID)
页面里没有 push_id，无法上传: No push_id in page, cannot upload
上传 start 没返回 x-goog-upload-url: Upload start did not return x-goog-upload-url
响应里没有图片 CDN 链接: No image CDN URL in response
没拿到会话 id，无法定位产物: No session ID returned, cannot locate artifact
视频被内容政策拒绝（换个 prompt 再试）: Video rejected by content policy (try another prompt)
hNvQHb 里没等到可下载的产物链接（response_data）: Did not receive downloadable artifact URL (response_data) in hNvQHb
还没有任何请求经过: No requests have passed through yet
服务端实际使用的模型与请求的不一致: The model actually used by the server differs from the one requested
每个代理是一个独立 IP slot: Each proxy is an independent IP slot
还没有代理。点「+ 添加代理」加一个。: No proxies yet. Click "+ Add proxy" to add one.
每行一个 Google 登录态账号: One logged-in Google account per row
缺 __Secure-1PSIDTS，首次保活会尝试补发；失败请用 Firefo: Missing __Secure-1PSIDTS; first keepalive will try to mint one. If that fails, re-export from Firefox
约 30 分钟过期，保活会自动换发: Expires in ~30 minutes; keepalive rotates it automatically
Cookie 池是空的。点「+ 导入 Cookie」加一个登录态账号。: The Cookie pool is empty. Click "+ Import Cookie" to add a logged-in account.
流量控制 · 每个 IP slot 独立计数: Rate limiting · counted per IP slot
无可用代理时退回直连: Fall back to direct when no proxy is available
cookie 失效时降级匿名: Downgrade to anonymous when cookie fails
同一时刻最多几个请求在飞，0=不限: Max requests in flight at once. 0 = unlimited
含首次；流式已吐字后不再重试: Includes the first attempt; no retry once streaming has begun emitting
客户端没传 model 时用哪个: Which model to use when the client sends no model
上游前端版本号。请求大面积失败时先看这里是不是过期了: Upstream frontend version number. When requests fail en masse, check here first for staleness
过期只删明细，聚合数据永久保留: Expiry deletes only detail rows; aggregate data is kept forever
启动时把文件内容导入 Cookie 池；之后从「Cookie 池」页面管理: Imports the file contents into the Cookie pool at startup; managed afterward from the "Cookie Pool" page
一个代理 = 一个独立 IP slot，享有独立的并发/RPM/RPH 配额。: One proxy = one independent IP slot with its own concurrency / RPM / RPH quota.
随便起，admin 面板里用来区分: Any name, just to tell them apart in the admin panel
仅用于面板里区分账号，不参与请求。: Only used to tell accounts apart in the panel; not sent with requests.
cookie 里没有 SAPISID，多半没复制全: No SAPISID in the cookie — you probably did not copy it all
只改标签、备注和账号序号，不动 cookie 本身。要换 cookie 请删掉重: Edits only the label, note and account index, not the cookie itself. To replace the cookie, delete and re-import.
浏览器里同时登了多个 Google 号时用：地址栏 /u/1/ 填 1，没有 /: For browsers with several Google accounts signed in: /u/1/ in the address bar means 1; no /u/ means 0.
账号序号要填 0 到 9 的整数: Account index must be a whole number from 0 to 9
退出后需要重新输入管理员 token 才能进来。服务本身不受影响，API 照常提: After logging out you must re-enter the admin token to get back in. The service itself is unaffected and the API keeps serving.
现有客户端在重新配置前将无法访问。确定继续？: Existing clients will be unable to access until reconfigured. Continue?
至少 20 字符。设置后所有客户端要更换为新 Key。: At least 20 characters. All clients must switch to the new key once set.
Key 至少 20 字符: Key must be at least 20 characters
算授权头用，缺了会被当匿名: Used for authorization header; treated as anonymous if missing
已越过红线，随时可能被拦: Crossed red line, may be blocked at any time
鉴权在失败，多半 cookie 过期了，建议用 Firefox 重新导出: Auth is failing, cookie likely expired; re-export with Firefox is recommended
还没成功用过，点「检测」确认: Not used successfully yet; click "Check" to verify
这些号鉴权在失败，多半 cookie 过期了，建议用 Firefox 重新导出: Auth is failing for these accounts, cookie likely expired; re-export with Firefox is recommended
调用成功。延迟 / 内容见上面字段。: Call succeeded. Latency and response content shown above.
Google 直接返回 429 限流。同样是 IP 嫌疑，但风控分支不同（朴素: Google returned 429 rate limit directly. Also IP-related risk control, but via standard SDK path.
上游 200 但只回了结束帧、没有内容帧，通常是请求被服务端拒绝（例如带了不被接: Upstream returned 200 with only end-frame and no content frames. Usually request rejected by server, not frame format change.
打一次真实请求看是否通。不消耗限流配额、不写入请求记录。 返回 302/429: Send a real request to verify connectivity. Does not consume rate limits or write to request logs. Returning 302/429 means the egress IP was blacklisted and needs rotation.
滚动 1 小时上限，0=不限。实测单出口 80-180 次被拦，默认取下沿 80: Rolling 1-hour limit, 0 = unlimited. Tested egress blocks at 80-180 requests, lower bound 80 is used by default. Can be set much higher at gentle rates (e.g. 10 req/min ran 800 times without blocks).
打开面板时自动检查更新: Check for updates when the panel opens
检查失败，浏览器连不上 GitHub: Check failed: the browser cannot reach GitHub
多把 Key，各自限制可用账号: Multiple keys with per-key account allowlists
留空保持当前 Key: Leave empty to keep the current key
改 Key 值会让旧 Key 立即失效。: Changing the key invalidates the old key immediately.
